title: Deployment and hosting setup
summary: Servers, Docker, automated deployments and backups set up so releases are repeatable and your site stays online.
description: We set up the servers your software runs on and the steps that put new versions live, so a release is one predictable step instead of a late-night manual job. Backups run on a schedule, and you get a short document explaining how everything is set up.
included: Server setup on AWS or your existing hosting
Automated deployments from your code repository
SSL certificates and basic security hardening
Scheduled backups and a setup document
